login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Open the app address in your browser. Your account was created by NeoSleep: use the email you were invited with.
steps: Type your password. The eye icon shows what you typed.
Leave “Remember me” ticked on your own device so you don't have to sign in every day. Untick it on a shared computer.
login.tip: Tip: add the app to your phone's home screen from the browser menu (“Add to Home screen”).

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.lead: On the sign-in screen tap “Forgot your password?”.
steps: Type the email of your account.
Tap “Send reset link”. Within a few minutes you will receive an email with a link.
forgot.tip: No email? Check your spam folder. For security the app doesn't say whether the address exists.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.lead: The link in the email opens this screen. It is valid for 1 hour and works once.
steps: Save it. From now on sign in with the new password.
reset.tip: Link expired? Request a new one from “Forgot your password?”.
